name: openshift
description: OpenShift command-line tools for managing containerized applications on Red Hat OpenShift

oc.description: OpenShift CLI for managing applications, builds, deployments, and cluster resources
oc.usage:
oc login https://api.cluster.com
oc new-app nodejs~https://github.com/user/app
oc get pods
oc logs deployment/myapp
oc scale --replicas=3 deployment/myapp
